company.name: Zenitus Technologies
company.description: IT consulting and software development group serving the technology needs of Japanese and global customers. Delivers offshore development, in-house packaged products (ClaimZ for insurance, TrackZ for tracking, RecruitZ for HR), consulting and outsourcing, 24/7 maintenance and software testing through a bilingual engineering team.

mission: Make a difference by enabling every business to run seamlessly through technology, staying customer-centric, simple and transparent.
vision: Digital transformation is an inevitable part of every business; make that transformation faster, easier and more cost-effective through technology.
